metadata.name: Meher Selmi
metadata.title: Senior Data Scientist | FinTech & AI
metadata.summary: Data Scientist with 5+ years of experience architecting and deploying machine learning models in startup environments, specializing in financial analytics, ESG modeling, and AI-driven credit scoring systems.

projects.title: Credit Score & ESG Report System
projects.description: End-to-end credit rating and ESG assessment platform delivering automated client reports integrating AI-based credit scoring, ESG metrics, and detailed financial analysis for holistic corporate creditworthiness  evaluation.
projects.outcome: Delivered 10,000+ end-to-end credit rating reports, reducing report generation time from days/weeks to near-instant

metrics.impact: Comprehensive risk view for investors, corporates, and regulators

projects.title: Semi-Automated ESG Modeling Framework
projects.description: Quantifies companies' environmental, social, and governance performance in a consistent and auditable way, surfacing actionable recommendations to drive measurable sustainability improvements.
projects.outcome: Significantly reduced manual assessment time and provided data-driven roadmaps for sovereign nations (Luxembourg, France)

projects.title: AI-Driven Credit Rating Platform
projects.description: Developed credit scoring system combining financial ratios and ESG signals, offering a faster and smarter alternative to traditional manual credit evaluations.
projects.outcome: Reduced corporate credit rating turnaround from several weeks to near-instant with 90%+ accuracy

projects.title: Competitor Market Analysis Dashboard
projects.description: Streamlit-based business intelligence platform managing competitor datasets with advanced tagging features (revenue, strategy, services), dynamic filters, and data visualization.
projects.outcome: Production-ready BI tool for competitive intelligence and market analysis

projects.title: LLM-Powered Quiz Application
projects.description: Local quiz generator for data science skill assessment leveraging pretrained LLM with prompt engineering. Demonstrates prompt engineering, backend logic, and API design.
projects.outcome: Functional quiz generator showcasing LLM integration and prompt design capabilities

projects.title: Used Car Price Prediction System
projects.description: End-to-end regression modeling system. Collected 10K+ car listings via web scraping from multiple automotive marketplaces and trained ML models achieving 92% R² accuracy.
projects.outcome: Predictive model with 92% R² accuracy; demonstrates data collection, feature engineering, and deployment capabilities

projects.title: Portfolio Chatbot (Interactive)
projects.description: Hybrid BM25 + Cloudflare Workers AI chatbot for portfolio discovery on GitHub Pages. Uses Mistral-7B for free LLM inference at scale.
projects.outcome: Deployment-ready architecture with free LLM inference
projects.status: nearly deployment-ready - awaiting actual Cloudflare Worker URL deployment

key_achievements: Delivered 10,000+ end-to-end credit rating reports covering financial analysis, credit scoring, and ESG assessment, reducing report generation time from days/weeks to near-instant
Built a semi-automated ESG model quantifying companies' environmental, social, and governance performance in consistent and auditable way
Developed sustainability reports for 2 sovereign nations (Luxembourg and France), providing data-driven roadmaps toward sustainability targets with gap analysis
Built AI models (with more than 90% accuracy) that reduced corporate credit rating turnaround from several weeks to near-instant, replacing manual opaque process
Guided and reviewed work of 3–5 junior data scientists, helping them grow from trainees to autonomous contributors
Owned AWS cloud setup (10+ services) end-to-end; from architecture decisions to day-to-day infrastructure management
Optimized logistics costs through data cleaning and ML model training for vehicle availability prediction
Deployed predictive models using Flask with Chart.js data visualization
Implemented route optimization using Google OR-Tools for vehicle routing

personal.personality_description: Bold explorer of the tangible world, driven by restless curiosity to understand how things work. Hands-on approach matched by adaptability. Thrive on solving immediate problems with practical logic and spontaneous creativity. Independent nature—prefer to chart own course relying on sharp analytical skills and hands-on experience rather than conventional wisdom.
strengths: Calm under pressure and crisis situations
Enjoys varied challenges and new learning
Highly adaptable to new tools and practices
personal.communication_style: Prefers clear, simple language over formal phrasing. Direct, concise style sometimes omits details. Values practical implementations and transparent discussions.

key_strengths: Expert in credit scoring and financial analytics
summary.unique_value: Combines deep technical expertise in ML and cloud computing with real-world fintech and sustainability domain experience, delivered in fast-paced startup environments. Pragmatic problem-solver with hands-on implementation focus.
